purpose: Machine-readable pre-implementation contract for introducing VerseGit into ClawX without source-tree pollution or LLM rewrite.

p0.correction: Unified DAG gates WP0-WP3 behind MC0-MC3 and MC5.
Per-entry effect matrix and provider-only diagnostic seams; CLI name allowlists are prohibited.
Single host cleanup barrier with stop, drain, seal, detach, verify, delete order.

p1.correction: Execution receipt binds plan, candidate, check, owner, epoch, inputs, scope, artifacts and cleanup.
Provider state contract defines M1 no-state, M2 host-created state, shared sidecar ownership, upgrade and rollback.
Provider delivery contract binds effective source, build recipe, lock inputs, platform and binary digest.
Input freeze contract covers Git and inprocess backends, dirty/untracked/ignored files and dependency inputs.
Every implementation node has a task-spec anchor, fixture, artifact, verifier and closure condition.
Evidence retention separates disposable resources from immutable evidence and defines atomic sealing.
Resource and soak contract defines bounded limits, three-way composition cases and performance tolerances.
TF-0481 is the sole ready node until planning correction and independent re-review close.
